subject.title: feat: Registry-safe Commerce Block Kit admin

question: Should this pilot preserve the existing native admin UI while adding the sandbox artifact, or is an intentionally non-upgradeable sandbox-only transition acceptable on main?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes an established native UI while documenting that populated native installations must not use the replacement; only maintainers can choose the compatibility contract for that transition.

options.title: Preserve native compatibility
options.body: Retain the native admin descriptor, pages, and package export while offering the sandbox artifact as an additional fresh-install path.

options.title: Adopt sandbox-only administration
options.body: Accept the native admin removal only with an explicitly approved upgrade boundary and a supported migration or prevention mechanism.

recommendation.title: Preserve native compatibility
recommendation.body: Retain the native admin descriptor, pages, and package export while offering the sandbox artifact as an additional fresh-install path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible recent contributor for the sandbox/admin implementation and can route the compatibility decision to the appropriate repository owner.
